title.narrative: Restoration of Forests and Mountain Ecosystems (ReFaME) in Far-West Nepal

description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

The project area is located in one of the least developed regions in Nepal with a high rate of outmigration especially among young men due to limited livelihood and economic opportunities. Livelihood improvement of the local communities based on ecosystem restoration and sustainable natural resource management is a core element of this project. The project will directly support community forest groups and agricultural communities to improve forest- and agriculture-based livelihoods by strengthening the value chains of sustainably-produced forest and agricultural products in collaboration with the private sector. The project will tap the potential of women and youth for entrepreneurship and marketing of forest and agricultural niche products and services. It will also develop and demonstrate innovative and sustainable nature-based solutions to ecosystem restoration and capacitate the local communities to implement them to enhance and sustain the ecosystems and natural resource base that support the local livelihood system. FFSs will be established to demonstrate innovative solutions to environmental problems such as forest fire, human-wildlife conflict, invasive species, low agricultural productivity, soil erosion, and climate hazards and facilitate community-to-community learning using inclusive approaches with due attention to the needs of women, youth and marginal communities. The project interventions are expected to directly benefit 88,232 local people including 50% female population. Demonstrated evidence of livelihood benefits from ecosystem restoration and biodiversity conservation is expected to enthuse further community conservation efforts, including revitalization of passive community forests, which will sustain the natural resource base for community livelihoods whilst generating multiple environmental benefits such as ecosystem restoration, increased carbon sequestration and reduced emissions, improved connectivity of natural habitats, recharging of water sources, and resilience to climate change. The project will ensure that the communities it supports fully adheres to government guidelines in social inclusion in community committees and equitable benefit sharing -- to avoid elite capture.
